services.name: Dolphin Sightseeing Tours
services.desc: Get up close with Anna Maria Island’s beautiful marine life! Choose from our public or private dolphin sightseeing tours: Public Tours - From $29.99/person: Set sail on a 90-minute adventure aboard our 30-passenger fun boat. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico while our expert captains guide you to the best spots for observing dolphins playing in their natural habitat. This memorable coastal journey offers the perfect blend of relaxation and excitement for guests of all ages. Whether you’re looking at kids entry level or a full day private charter, we have options for everyone! Florida native captains guide you through the Gulf of Mexico, Anna Maria Island & Sarasota Bay. services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: Explore the breathtaking beauty of Anna Maria Island and Robinson’s Preserve on a guided kayak tour. Wind through stunning mangrove tunnels, spot native wildlife, and immerse yourself in the peaceful natural surroundings. Experience the tranquility of these pristine coastal waterways while our expert guides share fascinating insights into the local ecosystem. This excursion provides a unique opportunity to observe manatees and exotic birds in their natural habitat, making it an essential adventure for nature lovers and families seeking a serene escape. blurb: Guests can parasail above Anna Maria Island and the Gulf Coast with views of dolphins and ocean life. They can also take guided kayak tours through mangroves, jet ski rentals, dolphin sightseeing tours on a 30-passenger boat, and boat trips to Egmont Key State Park. Wildlife such as dolphins, manatees, birds, and gopher tortoises can be seen during these activities.
